prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too high across all initial tests.
Evidence is still thin for specific change types (adoption redesign, sign_in hint, home wait_info) as each only has one test so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -3.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +1.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +4.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.7%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pet Adoption Spotlight Carousel Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a spotlight carousel layout with clear pet trait options. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and high median duration (89s), showing users struggle to pick a pet.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Summary Screen: Add a dedicated controls summary screen before home intro explaining system tray shortcuts and pet interactions. (why: Support mail highlighted confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet on desktop.)
2: [home, new_flow] Background Pet Generation Notification Flow: Enable system notification alerts while pet generation completes so users can safely minimize the app. (why: The waiting step has a very high mean duration (2336s) and median of 201s, causing severe drop-off while waiting.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Split Stage Redesign: Redesign the opening story screen into a split stage format featuring pet preview animations. (why: Choose path step has a mean duration of 514s, showing users hesitate or get stuck at the story intro.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Sign-in Recovery Warning Hint: Display a explicit notice on sign-in warning users to use their primary account to preserve adopted pets. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in with a different account.)
5: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Tip Carousel: Show a rotating carousel of desktop pet tips and shortcuts while pet generation is in progress. (why: High waiting screen drop-off and long mean time (2336s) leave users disengaged during setup.)
6: [adoption, copy] Photo Upload Guidelines Copy: Update photo upload headline and body text to specify ideal lighting and framing for custom pet generation. (why: Support received 3 complaints regarding custom pet generation failing or producing bad visual results.)
7: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Two-Column Layout: Switch the adoption certificate screen to a side-by-side two-column layout. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%), needing a more engaging adoption confirmation.)
8: [home, notification] System Tray Launch Notification Hint: Display a notification hint explaining that the app stays accessible in the taskbar tray if closed. (why: Support received 3 tickets where users reported the pet not appearing or app failing to open.)
